our_interpretation: The sentence rests on an assumption ('if we assume 3GW'), a theoretical expectation ('should (theoretically)'), and an impression ('nobody appears to be showing').

'Massive amounts of revenue' has no threshold. 'These data centers' refers to capacity added in 2025, but no company reports revenue by when its capacity came online. Hyperscalers, the largest operators, do not break out AI data center revenue at all.
Hardening this into a firm 2025 revenue test would supply a period and threshold the speaker did not give. That would be unfair to him, as reviewers noted. So the claim is treated as not checkable.
